rules: Library content is educational and can be displayed even when a supplement is not recommended.
Every library claim must map to one or more source_refs.
Evidence level is indication-specific; do not present a supplement as globally 'proven' or 'unproven'.
If recommendation is provisional, the library may explain why more information is needed but must not expose a personalized dose.
If result is professional_review_required, the library may show general reference information but not a personalized regimen.
Marketing goal labels must not alter the scientific content of the library record.
